title: Morning Briefing: Thursday 19 November 2026
excerpt: 13 new stories in the Rochdale borough since yesterday morning.
summary: 13 new stories in the Rochdale borough since yesterday morning.
content_html:
13 new stories in the Rochdale borough since yesterday morning.

The stories

  • Investigation launched into death of three-year-old boy at Middleton nursery Middleton
    A three-year-old boy has died after an incident at Cosy Toes Nursery in Middleton, prompting a police investigation and the nursery's closure.
  • Rochdale's Springhill Hospice wins three garden awards Rochdale
    An 18-strong volunteer gardening team has helped Springhill Hospice win three awards, including Best Hospice Garden in the North West 2026.
  • Rochdale Boroughwide Housing to demolish seven 1960s tower blocks Rochdale
    Rochdale Boroughwide Housing has announced plans to demolish seven landmark tower blocks on the College Bank site to make way for new homes.
  • Plans revealed to replace Rochdale’s Seven Sisters towers Rochdale
    DK Architects have unveiled initial designs for the redevelopment of the iconic Seven Sisters towers in Rochdale, with a public consultation set for next year.
  • Massive explosion rocks Rochdale, debris scattered across Bury Road Milnrow
    A significant explosion occurred in Rochdale on 17 November, scattering debris across Bury Road and prompting a swift emergency response.
  • Rochdale MP seeks local role in pilot targeting repeat shoplifters Rochdale
    Greater Manchester has been selected for a programme targeting repeat shop theft, but the locations have yet to be decided. Paul Waugh wants Rochdale included.
  • Falinge Park High School celebrates Artsmark Week with students Falinge
    Falinge Park High School recently hosted an Artsmark Celebration Week, recognising the contributions of students in Years 7 to 10.
  • Healey Dell tearooms win North West in Bloom gold for fifth year running Shawclough
    Healey Dell Heritage Centre and Tearooms has won North West in Bloom gold for a fifth year, and this year also took home a trophy.
  • Rochdale Masters Rugby League and Mayfield Movers raise £14,698 for charity Rochdale
    Rochdale Masters Rugby League and Mayfield Movers have raised a total of £14,698.67 for various charities over the past two years through their fundraising efforts, including a recent charity walk.
  • Breakfast with Santa at Queen's Park Café, Heywood Heywood
    Queen's Park Café in Heywood is hosting Breakfast with Santa on six mornings between Saturday 12 and Wednesday 23 December, each running from 10.30am to 12pm.
  • Christmas carols with Mustard Seed Church, Heywood Heywood
    Mustard Seed Church in Heywood is holding a Christmas carol morning on Sunday 20 December, starting at 9.30am, at Ian's Gate, to the rear of 193 Manchester Road.
  • Rochdale Metrolink patrols target knife crime during Sceptre week Rochdale
    Town centre PCSOs have patrolled the tram route between Newbold and Rochdale town centre as part of the national knife crime campaign.

Weather: Light rain 7°C in Rochdale today.

The Morning Briefing is published every day at 9am. Got a story? Tell the newsdesk.

13 new stories in the Rochdale borough since yesterday morning.

The stories:

Investigation launched into death of three-year-old boy at Middleton nursery (Middleton). A three-year-old boy has died after an incident at Cosy Toes Nursery in Middleton, prompting a police investigation and the nursery's closure.

Rochdale's Springhill Hospice wins three garden awards (Rochdale). An 18-strong volunteer gardening team has helped Springhill Hospice win three awards, including Best Hospice Garden in the North West 2026.

Rochdale Boroughwide Housing to demolish seven 1960s tower blocks (Rochdale). Rochdale Boroughwide Housing has announced plans to demolish seven landmark tower blocks on the College Bank site to make way for new homes.

Plans revealed to replace Rochdale’s Seven Sisters towers (Rochdale). DK Architects have unveiled initial designs for the redevelopment of the iconic Seven Sisters towers in Rochdale, with a public consultation set for next year.

Massive explosion rocks Rochdale, debris scattered across Bury Road (Milnrow). A significant explosion occurred in Rochdale on 17 November, scattering debris across Bury Road and prompting a swift emergency response.

Rochdale MP seeks local role in pilot targeting repeat shoplifters (Rochdale). Greater Manchester has been selected for a programme targeting repeat shop theft, but the locations have yet to be decided. Paul Waugh wants Rochdale included.

Falinge Park High School celebrates Artsmark Week with students (Falinge). Falinge Park High School recently hosted an Artsmark Celebration Week, recognising the contributions of students in Years 7 to 10.

Healey Dell tearooms win North West in Bloom gold for fifth year running (Shawclough). Healey Dell Heritage Centre and Tearooms has won North West in Bloom gold for a fifth year, and this year also took home a trophy.

Rochdale Masters Rugby League and Mayfield Movers raise £14,698 for charity (Rochdale). Rochdale Masters Rugby League and Mayfield Movers have raised a total of £14,698.67 for various charities over the past two years through their fundraising efforts, including a recent charity walk.

Breakfast with Santa at Queen's Park Café, Heywood (Heywood). Queen's Park Café in Heywood is hosting Breakfast with Santa on six mornings between Saturday 12 and Wednesday 23 December, each running from 10.30am to 12pm.

Christmas carols with Mustard Seed Church, Heywood (Heywood). Mustard Seed Church in Heywood is holding a Christmas carol morning on Sunday 20 December, starting at 9.30am, at Ian's Gate, to the rear of 193 Manchester Road.

Rochdale Metrolink patrols target knife crime during Sceptre week (Rochdale). Town centre PCSOs have patrolled the tram route between Newbold and Rochdale town centre as part of the national knife crime campaign.

Weather: Light rain 7°C in Rochdale today.
